findings.title: Asset bought in cash above limit
findings.message: Asset bought in cash above the limit; that amount is not counted in tax depreciation. ₹18,000.00 paid in cash for 'Furniture & Fixtures' on 08-10-2025. Vouchers: Payment 322 dt 08-10-2025.
findings.suggestion: Exclude this amount from the asset's cost for tax depreciation.

findings.title: Cash payment above limit
findings.message: Cash paid for an expense/purchase to one person in a day is above the limit. The expense may be disallowed. ₹40,000.00 paid in cash to 'Shree Roadlines' on 01-06-2025 (limit ₹35,000.00). Vouchers: Payment 114 dt 01-06-2025.
findings.suggestion: Check Rule 6DD exceptions; otherwise consider disallowance in tax computation.

findings.title: Cash payment above limit
findings.message: Cash paid for an expense/purchase to one person in a day is above the limit. The expense may be disallowed. ₹13,500.00 paid in cash to 'Shree Ganesh Hardware' on 16-05-2025 (limit ₹10,000.00). Vouchers: Payment 73 dt 16-05-2025; Payment 74 dt 16-05-2025.
findings.suggestion: Check Rule 6DD exceptions; otherwise consider disallowance in tax computation.

findings.title: Cash payment above limit
findings.message: Cash paid for an expense/purchase to one person in a day is above the limit. The expense may be disallowed. Payment 91 dt 21-05-2025: ₹12,500.00 paid in cash for 'Repairs & Maintenance' (limit ₹10,000.00).
findings.suggestion: Check Rule 6DD exceptions; otherwise consider disallowance in tax computation.

findings.title: Cash received ₹2 lakh or more
findings.message: Cash of ₹2 lakh or more received from one person in a day / one transaction. Penalty may apply. ₹2,10,000.00 received in cash from 'Om Sai Enterprises' on 03-09-2025. Vouchers: Receipt 213 dt 03-09-2025; Receipt 214 dt 03-09-2025.
findings.suggestion: Receipt of ₹2 lakh or more in cash from a person in a day attracts penalty.

findings.title: Cash received ₹2 lakh or more
findings.message: Cash of ₹2 lakh or more received from one person in a day / one transaction. Penalty may apply. Sales 333 dt 08-09-2025: ₹2,50,000.00 received in cash ('Sales - Local').
findings.suggestion: Identify the customer; receipt of ₹2 lakh or more in cash attracts penalty.

findings.title: Possible duplicate voucher
findings.message: Two vouchers have the same date, ledgers and amounts. Sales 413 dt 18-10-2025 looks the same as Sales 412 dt 18-10-2025.
findings.suggestion: Delete one if it was entered twice.

findings.message: Loan taken in cash where the loan (with earlier unpaid principal) is ₹20,000 or more. Receipt 121 dt 30-06-2025: ₹10,000.00 accepted from 'Loan from Anil Joshi' (cash); unpaid principal before this ₹15,000.00, aggregate ₹25,000.00.
findings.suggestion: Report in Form 3CD clause 31(a) with mode; check penalty exposure.

findings.title: Loan grouped as creditor/debtor
findings.message: This looks like a loan but is grouped as a party. Loans go under Borrowings, and cash loan limits apply. 'Loan from Suresh Kumar' looks like a loan taken but is under 'Sundry Creditors'.
findings.suggestion: Move to Unsecured Loans / Secured Loans (Borrowings). Cash-loan limits are already being tested on it.

findings.title: Overdraft / cash credit grouped as bank account
findings.message: Overdraft and cash credit accounts are borrowings, not bank balances. 'State Bank of India CC A/c' is under Bank Accounts.
findings.ledger: State Bank of India CC A/c
findings.suggestion: Move to Bank OD A/c (shown under Short-term Borrowings).
findings.key: MISGROUP_OD:State Bank of India CC A/c

findings.title: Tax ledger grouped as creditor
findings.message: GST/TDS ledgers belong under Duties & Taxes (statutory dues), not trade creditors. 'GST Payable - Old' is under 'Sundry Creditors'.
findings.suggestion: Move to Duties & Taxes.

findings.title: Cash balance negative
findings.message: Cash in hand went below zero at the end of this day, which is not possible in reality. 'Cash' closed 18-09-2025 at 10,000.00 Cr.
findings.suggestion: Check missing cash receipts / withdrawals, or wrong dates.

findings.title: Opening balance differs from last year's closing
findings.message: This ledger's opening this year does not match its closing last year. 'Customer 03': opening this year 1,15,296.37 Dr, expected 1,10,296.37 Dr (last year's closing). Difference ₹5,000.00.
findings.suggestion: Correct the opening balance, or record the reason (e.g. prior-period adjustment).

findings.title: Opening balance differs from last year's closing
findings.message: This ledger's opening this year does not match its closing last year. 'Partner B - Capital': opening this year 19,48,848.21 Cr, expected 19,43,848.21 Cr (last year's closing). Difference ₹5,000.00.
findings.suggestion: Correct the opening balance, or record the reason (e.g. prior-period adjustment).

findings.title: Opening balance differs from last year's closing
findings.message: This ledger's opening this year does not match its closing last year. 'Profit & Loss A/c': opening this year 5,000.00 Cr, expected 0.00 Dr (last year's closing plus last year's profit/loss). Difference ₹5,000.00.
findings.suggestion: Correct the opening balance, or record the reason (e.g. prior-period adjustment).

findings.title: Last year's ledger missing this year
findings.message: A ledger had a closing balance last year but is not in this year's books. 'Old Debtor' closed last year at 7,000.00 Dr but is not in this year's books.
findings.suggestion: Check if it was renamed or merged.

findings.title: New ledger with opening balance
findings.message: A ledger has an opening balance but did not exist last year. 'Old Debtor - Renamed' has opening 7,000.00 Dr but no such ledger existed last year.
findings.suggestion: Check if the ledger was renamed; if so, link it to last year's name.

findings.title: Income/expense ledger has an opening balance
findings.message: Income and expense ledgers must start the year at zero. 'Rent' starts the year with 5,000.00 Dr.

findings.title: Suspense account has a balance
findings.message: Suspense must be cleared before finalising. 'Suspense A/c' shows 1,234.00 Cr.

findings.title: Possible capital item in expenses
findings.message: This expense ledger name suggests an asset purchase. Check whether it should be capitalised. 'Laptop Purchase' (Indirect Expenses) shows 65,000.00 Dr.
findings.suggestion: If it gives benefit for more than a year, move to Fixed Assets and charge depreciation.
